$comment: Lighthouse CI configuration. INERT until `@lhci/cli` is installed — nothing in
the repository runs it today, and this file does not pretend otherwise.
Why it exists: `apps/web/lighthouserc.json` was written for `@lhci/cli` in 2026-09
and then never used by anything. The `lighthouse` CLI (which IS installed, and
which the old scripts/check-cwv.mjs tried to point at this file with
`--config-path`) does not read an LHCI `ci` block and has no such flag for one.
The budget in there was therefore never enforced by anything, and the script
that named it printed success unconditionally.
The enforced gate today is `scripts/check-cwv.mjs`, which drives the Lighthouse
Node API directly, measures cold and warm separately, and refuses to pass when
it cannot measure. Its budgets live in docs/performance/cwv-budgets.json so the
script and this file cannot drift apart by being edited in two places: the
values below are transcribed from there and the negative test in
docs/performance/core-web-vitals.md is what proves the enforced path.
To make this file live:  pnpm -C apps/web add -D @lhci/cli
and then run:  pnpm exec lhci autorun
Note that @lhci/cli measures a *lab* run only, and does not distinguish cold
from warm. For the budget this repository is actually held to, use
pnpm -C apps/web test:cwv
which requires a production server and fails loudly when there is none.
